method.cpu_measure: Time Profiler actual weight values (100us samples); totals include missing-stack samples, inclusive weights count a unique symbol per sample.
method.gap_alignment: Raw longest callback interval uptime offsets relative to each corresponding exact operation signpost. Small mark-to-signpost call latency remains. Coverage is sampled Running CPU weight divided by callback interval duration.
limitations: Profiles separate from unprofiled timings; substantial profiler overhead is visible.
